en-US:
• Redesigned Home Screen widgets put friends and shared cities at a glance, with light and dark appearances.

• A simpler city picker, one calendar for date ranges, and a cleaner New trip screen.
• Improved Chinese translations and iOS 27 interface refinements.

reviewNotes:
Across Us uses Sign in with Apple. Reviewers can create an account with their own Apple Account; no shared login is required.

Version 1.0.4 (23) includes redesigned Home Screen widgets, Chinese localization improvements, the Friend plans refresh fix, calendar badges for friends' shared plans, and same-city notification improvements. Screenshots use example data and actual app/widget views.

To check widgets, add the Across Us widget to the Home Screen and try the Friends and Here together designs, in light and dark appearance. Widget privacy and preferred-friend options are retained.

To test plans with two Apple Accounts: add each other as friends. In You > Travel plans, create a city/date plan on account A and select account B. Open Friends > Friend plans on B, or tap A's friend card. The selected friends can see plans by default, including older plans. The owner can turn off plan visibility, change selected friends or delete the plan. A plan with no selected friends remains owner-only. Joining a group Trip does not create a personal plan.

For group travel, create a Trip, invite a friend and add a flight. Open the ongoing Trip to view the route map and expand a flight's details. Flight-planning reminders can be turned off per Trip.

Precise coordinates are processed on-device; the server stores city, optional region and update time. Notification delivery requires iOS permission. Account deletion is under You.
